verdict.rationale: AMD documents that ROCm is 'primarily open-source' and supports Linux for the RX 9070 XT with mainstream frameworks (PyTorch, vLLM, llama.cpp), which aligns with open-driver/upstream support claims. However, the evidence does not explicitly confirm upstream Linux kernel (amdgpu) mainline support or detail which ROCm kernel components are open-source vs proprietary userspace blobs, nor any Mesa/upstream kernel documentation. missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation of upstream kernel module (amdgpu) inclusion, clarity on which ROCm components are closed-source, and independent confirmation of open kernel driver status.
